_doc: The Grand Underground (notes/UNDERGROUND.md; DECISIONS 2026-10-19 and the lead's answers of 2026-10-26). Read by b2tools/patches/underground.py and b2tools/underground_check.py; the Hideaways' Pokémon are data/underground_pokemon.json (b2tools/underground_lists.py). Tiles are each map's own tile numbers (the tunnels: Pearl's matrix 2; a Hideaway: its room's matrix). Rooms: a Pearl room = its installed matrix, chunks and area (data/sinnoh_world.json rooms); a Unova room = Black 2's own (vanilla) matrix, chunks and area of that zone. 'exits': the room's warps (by index) that lead back to the tunnel hole; its other warps never fire. 'items': BDSP's Hideaway items (Bulbapedia's Hideaway pages), one ball each, flags PFLAG_UG_ITEM_nn in order; 'move:X' = the TM that teaches move X here (Black 2's TM or Pearl's TM96-TM120), BDSP's TM62 Bug Buzz (no TM here) = Pearl's TM62 Silver Wind. 'shard': a daily Mysterious Shard ball (S or L) from becoming Champion (flags PFLAG_UG_SHARD_n in order). 'fossil': a daily fossil ball from becoming Champion (flags PFLAG_UG_FOSSIL_n in order). 'grotto': Black 2's Hidden Grotto id (0-17), its 'narrow path' wall tile (read facing north) and the past-generation starters of its Pokémon slot of 15 %.
_visible: Part 2 (the user 2026-10-26, BDSP's Hideaways): the Pokémon walk about in the Hideaways (gimmick 63, the decomp's hideaway_itcm.c) and touching one starts its battle; no random battles there. false: part 1's random battles.
_levels: BDSP's Hideaway levels by badges (Serebii, Bulbapedia): row 0 = 0-1 badge, row n = n + 1 badges, row 8 = the Champion beaten (game clear).
_unlock: BDSP's stages (opendpr GetStoryNo): 2 Strength obtained (HM04), 3 Defog obtained (TM119), 4 the Icicle Badge (Pearl's 7th), 5 Waterfall obtained (Black 2's HM05), 6 BDSP's National Pokédex = becoming Champion here (Black 2's game-clear flag 2400 = Pearl's 0x964; user 2026-10-26). As BDSP, the highest stage whose condition holds counts.
_fossil_items: The Kanto and Hoenn fossils (Pearl digs them up after the National Pokédex): two daily balls from becoming Champion (the lead 2026-10-26), in the two Oreburgh Mine rooms (Rocky Cave, Sandsear Cave), each one of the five at random when picked up (flags PFLAG_UG_FOSSIL_n).
_shard_items: Mysterious Shard S / L: the Ramanas Park agent's item ids (proposed, final after the user's answers).

grotto_items._doc: What the grottos' item slots hold (Black 2's 7 item slots: A at 1/4/10/25 %, B at 1/4/10 % of the refills; 4 groups each): Pearl's Underground treasures, which have no other source here without digging (the plates, the Armor Fossil (Pearl's version fossil before the National Pokédex), evolution stones, shards, Heart Scales, Star Pieces, Rare Bones). Group g of grotto n uses entry (n + g) mod len of each list. 'slate': kept for the Discovery Slates of Ramanas Park (Heart Scale until their ids come).
